en-US.longDescription: NetEase QIYU is a SaaS cloud customer service product under NetEase, dedicated to reducing enterprise management costs, improving customer satisfaction, and solving problems for customers anytime, anywhere through self-developed customer service robots. With the product creed of "QIYU changes customer service, service creates value," it provides a complete set of service solutions for enterprises in terms of customer service efficiency, customer service awareness, and customer service specialization.
en-US.name: 网易七鱼

zh-CN.longDescription: 网易七鱼是网易旗下的一款 SaaS 模式的云客服产品，致力于通过自主研发的客服机器人为企业客户降低企业管理成本，提高客户满意度，随时随地解决客户问题。以“七鱼改变客服，服务创造价值”的产品理念，为企业在客服工作效率、客服服务意识、客服专业化方面提供一整套的服务解决方案。
zh-CN.name: 网易七鱼
